CREATE_OIDC.APP_TYPE_MOBILE_HELPER: For iOS and Android apps. Uses a public client with PKCE, and the app receives tokens in the token response.
CREATE_OIDC.DESCRIPTION_NEW: Enter details to generate a new key
CREATE_OIDC.DEVICE_FLOW_LABEL: Generate this OIDC client only for device flow
CREATE_OIDC.IDENTITY_PROVIDER_INFO: Adds a matching Blocks OIDC entry under Identity Provider, so other Blocks projects can offer this project as a sign-in option and federate their users to it. Uncheck if this client is only used by your own app to sign users in — you can always add the provider later.
CREATE_OIDC.IDENTITY_PROVIDER_INFO_LABEL: More about Blocks OIDC identity providers
CREATE_OIDC.IDENTITY_PROVIDER_LABEL: Register as a Blocks OIDC identity provider
CREATE_OIDC.LIFETIME_ABSOLUTE_ARIA: Refresh token maximum lifetime in minutes
CREATE_OIDC.LIFETIME_ABSOLUTE_NOTE: Signs the user out after this time, even when active. At least the idle time.
CREATE_OIDC.LIFETIME_ACCESS_NOTE: How long a sign-in stays valid before the app must refresh it. Shorter is safer.
CREATE_OIDC.LIFETIME_REFRESH_ARIA: Refresh token idle lifetime in minutes
CREATE_OIDC.LIFETIME_REFRESH_NOTE: Signs the user out after this long without using the app.
CREATE_OIDC.MODE_CUSTOM_HINT: Set different values for this client only.
CREATE_OIDC.PROJECT_SUMMARY_FALLBACK: The values set for the whole project.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_ABSOLUTE_BELOW: Refresh token maximum lifetime must be at least the refresh token idle lifetime.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_ABSOLUTE_LIFET: Refresh token maximum lifetime must be between 1 and 525600 minutes.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_ACCESS_LIFETIM: Access token lifetime must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_HTTPS_REDIRECT: Enter a valid HTTPS URL with a public domain (e.g. https://example.com/callback). Localhost may use HTTP.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_MOBILE_INVALID: Enter an HTTPS URL or a mobile app URI such as com.example.app://callback.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_REDIRECT_URI_M: At least one redirect URI is required
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_REFRESH_LIFETI: Refresh token idle lifetime must be between 1 and 525600 minutes.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_RESPONSE_TYPE_: At least one response type is required
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_SELECT_PROVIDE: Select at least one provider, or choose Default.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_WEB_APP_SCHEME: Mobile app redirect URIs need the Mobile app application type.
CREATE_OIDC_UTILS.MESSAGE_WHOLE_NUMBER: Enter a whole number of minutes.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.GENERAL_DESCRIPTION: The name people see on the login page, and the kind of app this client is for.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.IDENTITY_PROVIDER_DESCR: Let other Blocks projects offer this project as a sign-in option.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.NOT_FOUND_TITLE: This OIDC client could not be loaded
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.REDIRECT_URIS_DESCRIPTI: Where Blocks sends people back after they sign in.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.SAVE_HINT: Changes apply from the next sign-in.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: Status, scopes and how the code exchange is protected.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.SIGN_IN_DESCRIPTION: How people sign in to this app on the Blocks login page.
OIDC_CLIENT_PAGE.TOKEN_LIFETIMES_DESCRIP: How long a sign-in lasts for this app.

OIDC_SIGN_IN_SECTION.PICK_ONE_PER_PROVID: Pick at most one entry per provider. The login page shows one button for each provider you pick.
OIDC_SIGN_IN_SECTION.PROVIDERS_DEFAULT_H: All enabled providers, new ones included
OIDC_SIGN_IN_SECTION.PROVIDERS_SELECTED_: One entry per provider, chosen below
